name: Autocomplete component with Shadcn UI
summary: Write-up with a live demo of a custom autocomplete select component built with shadcn/ui and Fancy Multi Select.
description: Blog post from July 2023 demonstrating an autocomplete component built on the shadcn/ui select, based on Fancy Multi Select by Maximilian Kaske. The demo now points to a frozen StackBlitz project and a source snapshot on GitHub.
